steps.title: Reactor 1 – approach
do: Follow Barret and Biggs through the station and into the reactor.
Open the chests along the way.
tips: Learn the Materia menu early: equip Cure/Fire when you find them.

steps.title: Reactor 1 – Guard Scorpion
boss: Guard Scorpion counters physical attacks when its tail is raised.
Attack it while the tail is down; use Fire/magic when it is up.
tips: Don't hit it with physical attacks while the tail is raised – it counters with Tail Laser.

steps.title: Escape the reactor
do: Set the bomb timer and run out following the marked route.
Use the save point before leaving if you have not saved.

steps.title: Back at Seventh Heaven
steps.text: Talk to Tifa and Barret, then explore the Sector 7 slums and shops before taking the next job.
tips: Buy a few Potions and Phoenix Downs when you can.
